content: Feature Level Transfer Learning (TL2): In this flavor, a model was trained on one dataset and only learned word embeddings were transferred to another dataset for training a new model. As compared to TL1, recall score improved dramatically with TL2 (Table TABREF25 ). Improvement in precision was also significant (Table TABREF25 ). These improvements indicate that learned word embeddings are an essential part of knowledge transfer across datasets for cyberbullying detection.
